# The setting sun: a 16-sided disc 3.6 m across, standing at the sea's far edge, half under the
# horizon; a ring of the warmer step round it. Unlit. Faces the camera (-Y). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Sun --base-color 1.0000 0.9608 0.2510 --emission 1.0000 0.9608 0.2510 --no-slot
material new Halo --base-color 1.0000 0.8118 0.5569 --emission 1.0000 0.8118 0.5569 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Halo --vertices 16 --radius 1.9 --depth 0.1 --location 0 0.15 0
material assign Halo
add mesh cylinder --name Sun --vertices 16 --radius 1.5 --depth 0.1 --location 0 0 0
material assign Sun
select Halo Sun
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
select all
shade flat
export sun.glb
